name: MinIO
label: MinIO S3-compatible object storage
description: MinIO S3-compatible object storage. Official API https://min.io/docs/minio/linux/developers/minio-drivers.html. One node; pick operation. Downloaded payloads may appear as OUTPUT file. Auth is AWS SigV4 (access_key + secret_key + region); baseUrl is config endpoint. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Customer-hosted S3 API. No vendor SaaS terms. Path-style vs virtual-host is an endpoint choice. Set endpoint to the real origin (scheme + host).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port. File bytes are type file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: bucket_create, bucket_delete, bucket_list, object_get, object_put, object_delete, object_list, presign.

schema.label: bucket
schema.description: S3 bucket name for all object/bucket ops. Example: invoices.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Object bytes for object_put. Platform file list. Sent as the raw PUT body (S3 PutObject).

schema.label: list-type
schema.description: object_list ListObjects version. Official S3: 2 = ListObjectsV2. Example: 2.

schema.label: delimiter
schema.description: object_list delimiter (usually /) to group common prefixes. Example: /.

schema.label: continuation-token
schema.description: object_list ListObjectsV2 continuation token from a previous response.

schema.label: max-keys
schema.description: object_list max keys to return. S3 default 1000. Example: 100.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: MinIO secret key for AWS SigV4. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key
configurationParameters.description: MinIO access key for AWS SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Endpoint
configurationParameters.description: MinIO S3 API origin including scheme, e.g. https://minio.example.com:9000. Interpolated as api_spec baseUrl.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: S3 region for SigV4 signing. MinIO default us-east-1.
